meta.title: Jamal Akinola — Backend Engineer
meta.description: Backend engineer building payment infra and developer tools. Co-founder of InventPay and Deployzy.

hero.name: Jamal Akinola
hero.tagline: I build the boring infrastructure that lets other people ship fast — payments, deploy tooling, and everything in between.

about: I'm a backend and blockchain engineer from Nigeria. I like problems where reliability actually matters — money moving, apps deploying, systems that can't just fall over. Lately I've been building Deployzy, an open-source way to deploy apps, databases and tunnels from one place.

projects.name: Deployzy
projects.description: Open-source platform to deploy apps from GitHub, run managed databases, and tunnel localhost — bring your own VPS.

projects.name: InventPay
projects.description: Crypto payment infrastructure — accept BTC, ETH and stablecoins with a clean API and SDKs.

projects.name: CryptoSignal Bot
projects.description: A Telegram bot that scans exchanges and on-chain data for trade signals in real time.

experience.detail: Building the deploy + database + tunnel platform end to end.
Crypto payment rails, API and SDKs for merchants.

contact.sub: Open to collaborations and interesting infra problems.
